compositionEvidence.draftIntent: Compose the accepted WebGPU-compatible modules as one non-literal Rudolf Bauer-inspired radial dispute structure: an all-over lattice of incomplete rings and flexible lanes binds, resists, and partially reopens around a concentrated rust seam, while a small red Voici cue marks the selected pressure point inside the fuller Bpost-booksellers dispute.

invariants: The cream diagonal opening remains broad and visibly empty between paired edges.
Incomplete rings and flexible lanes read through frontal depth and into left, right, and rear azimuths rather than as one small centered rectangle.
The rust seam and small red Voici marker remain distinct without depending on post-processing.
The accepted direction-space environment provides intentional muted surround coverage in every labeled direction.
The supplied camera remains byte-for-byte unchanged in all declared fields.

rendererCompatibilityPreserved: world-environment preserves accepted MeshBasicMaterial, sky-background-field, and direction-space-skybox-shell evidence facts and compatible surfaces.
radial-dispute-lattice preserves accepted MeshBasicMaterial and MeshStandardMaterial evidence facts and compatible surfaces.
No ShaderMaterial, RawShaderMaterial, GLSL post pass, onBeforeCompile patch, CPU texture bake, new helper claim, or replacement module was introduced.
compositionEvidence.outputOwnership: world.outputColorTransform is the sole final tone/contrast/saturation/exposure/vignette grade; accepted parts remain mountable scene modules and own no renderer post stack.
compositionEvidence.priorAttemptDiagnosis: Attempt 2 proved that the accepted generated-part mount ignored a substantial standard position/rotation/scale change: desktop, mobile, and surround screenshots were byte-identical to attempt 1. Attempt 3 retains the same accepted module and tests a stronger standard root request without source or moduleRef changes.
